sin.name: sql-outside-database-layer
sin.description: SQL text is written outside base/database, base/query, a migration, a module's views.py or its conditions, so its table and column names go unchecked.
sin.rule: Name the statement in the database layer (base/database) or build it with the query builder, and use it from there. Temporary task 6613 exceptions name tasks/models/support/views.py and drivers/models/support/views.py: closed_task_counts_select and tool_use_counts_select are query builders that must leave views.py at the final judge after worker 570 merges.
